ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Data Exfiltration Activity Via CommandLine Tools
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of various CLI utilities exfiltrating data via web requests

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*curl\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-RestMethod.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-WebRequest.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*irm\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*iwr\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wget\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-ur.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-me.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-b.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ POST\\ .*"))) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\curl\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-ur.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-d\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-data\\ .*"))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\wget\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-post\\-data.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-post\\-file.*")))) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*Get\\-Content.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*GetBytes.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*hostname.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ifconfig.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ipconfig.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*net\\ view.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*netstat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*nltest.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*qprocess.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*sc\\ query.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*systeminfo.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*tasklist.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ToBase64String.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*whoami.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*type\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\>\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ C\\:\\\\.*")))
